Now I'll create the LAMMPS input script for the melting simulation. The script will:
1. Load the structure and replicate 3x3x3
2. Use SW potential for Silicon
3. Heat from 300K to 2500K under NPT conditions
4. Compute MSD for diffusion constant calculation

{"path": "/results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_3/brief/silicon_melting_3_trial_0/melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Silicon melting simulation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate 3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber for Silicon
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 0 every 1 check yes

# Compute settings
compute msd_compute all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol etotal ke pe density c_msd_compute[4]

# Equilibration at 300K in NPT
velocity all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix npt_eq all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
timestep 0.001
run 10000
unfix npt_eq

# Reset MSD compute
uncompute msd_compute
compute msd_compute all msd com yes

# Heating from 300K to 2500K under NPT
# heating_rate = 2.2 K/ps, temperature range = 2200K
# time needed = 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps (with dt=0.001 ps)
fix npt_heat all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 1000000

# Hold at 2500K for equilibration in molten state
unfix npt_heat
fix npt_melt all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 50000

# Production run at 2500K to compute diffusion
# Reset MSD for accurate diffusion calculation
uncompute msd_compute
compute msd_compute all msd com yes
reset_timestep 0

# Dump MSD data for diffusion calculation
fix msd_output all print 100 "$(step) $(c_msd_compute[4])" file msd.dat screen no title "# Step MSD"

thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press vol etotal ke pe density c_msd_compute[4]
run 100000

write_data final_structure.data
"}

{"path": "/results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/subtask_false/level_3/brief/silicon_melting_3_trial_0/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read MSD data
data = np.loadtxt('msd.dat')
steps = data[:, 0]
msd = data[:, 1]  # MSD in Angstrom^2

# Convert to time (timestep = 0.001 ps in metal units)
time = steps * 0.001  # time in ps

# Fit linear region to get diffusion coefficient
# MSD = 6*D*t for 3D diffusion
# We'll use the latter half of the data for fitting (more equilibrated)
start_idx = len(time) // 2
time_fit = time[start_idx:]
msd_fit = msd[start_idx:]

# Linear fit: MSD = 6*D*t
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # This is 6*D in Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
D_angstrom2_ps = slope / 6.0  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 m^2 / 1e-12 s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Diffusion coefficient from MSD slope:")
print(f"  Slope (6D): {slope:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D: {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"  D: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")

# Save result
with open('diffusion_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"{D_m2_s:.6e}\n")

# Create plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time, msd, 'b-', label='MSD data', linewidth=1)
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', 
         label=f'Linear fit (D={D_m2_s:.3e} m²/s)', linewidth=2)
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)')
plt.ylabel('MSD (Angstrom²)')
plt.title('Mean Square Displacement vs Time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")
"}
